learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basics of strength of materials and can apply the methods of strength of materials to technical problems.
They can determine stresses and deformations.
They can perform a strength analysis.
They can analyze simple stability problems.

syllabus_topics: Stresses, strains, constitutive law: Normal and shear stresses; displacements and strains; relationship between stress and deformation; thermal expansion, thermal stress
Statically determinate and statically indeterminate bar systems
Bending of beams: Bending stress, area moments of inertia; deflection; statically indeterminate structures; shear force
Torsion of structures and machine parts
Plane stress and strain state: Strength hypotheses
Energy methods, application to statically determinate systems
assessment_rules: The module final exam (Klausur) lasts 120 minutes and accounts for 100% of the module grade. The allocation of credits depends on successfully passing this module final exam.
